# `kernel/net/netns` — the Xerox NS protocol family

## English

This directory contains the Xerox NS protocol family.

`config.mk` records 11 source file(s) here: `idp_usrreq.c`, `ns.c`, `ns_cksum.c`, `ns_error.c`, `ns_input.c`, `ns_ip.c`, `ns_output.c`, `ns_pcb.c`, `ns_proto.c`, `spp_debug.c`, `spp_usrreq.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
